title: Microsoft 365: pay-as-you-go meter for SharePoint storage above the tenant quota
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap, Microsoft's supplied notice and the cited documentation. One qualification would help administrators: the billing setup article permits four administrator roles, while the storage-specific prerequisites list only SharePoint Administrator or Global Administrator.

claims.where: controls[3]; Cost and licensing: Caps; Why it matters
claims.claim: No hard spending cap or automatic billing stop is documented for SharePoint storage on either the UI or API surface.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 pay as you go billing policy budget configure API PowerShell hard spending cap SharePoint storage. Opened billing-node setup, add-storage-space and pricing; searched budget excerpts document alerts, not a hard cap.

claims.claim: The connection control is in Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Pay-as-you-go > Services > Connect a policy > Connection status.
claims.quote: go to Billing > Pay-as-you-go. ... select the Services tab. ... select Connect a policy. ... select the Connection status toggle to set it to Connected.

claims.claim: No PowerShell, Microsoft Graph or REST call is documented for connecting this SharePoint storage service.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 SharePoint Storage pay as you go billing policy connect PowerShell Graph REST API. Opened billing-node setup and add-storage-space; results document UI connection, not a call for this service.

claims.claim: Create a billing policy at Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Pay-as-you-go > Billing policies > Add a billing policy.
claims.quote: go to Billing > Pay-as-you-go. ... On the Billing policies tab, select Add a billing policy.

claims.claim: No PowerShell, Graph or REST call is documented for creating this service's billing policy and assigning its Azure billing resources.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 SharePoint Storage pay as you go billing policy connect PowerShell Graph REST API. Opened billing-node setup and add-storage-space; no applicable creation call found; Backup application billing is a different service.

claims.claim: A subscription or resource group associated with a billing policy cannot be edited.

claims.claim: Budget settings are under Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Pay-as-you-go > Billing policies > policy > Budget > Settings.
claims.quote: On the Billing policies tab, select a billing policy. ... select the Budget tab. ... To configure your budget and alert preferences, select Settings.

claims.claim: No API or automation call is documented for configuring this Microsoft 365 billing policy's budget and alerts.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 pay as you go billing policy budget configure API PowerShell hard spending cap SharePoint storage. Opened billing-node setup and reviewed budget search excerpts; no applicable budget configuration call found.
